A few reminders about treat supplies
It is for regular visitors
Travelers should keep pet supplies ready and follow desk guidance before each trip.

Pet Travel Notice

Please bring your animal's carrier, feeding items, and any comfort item you normally use for a calm journey. Our handlers use calm, humane methods around animals, and the ground team moves carriers carefully between services so each pet stays as settled as possible. If you are traveling with a companion animal, please check that the carrier is secure, easy to carry, and sized for safe handling.

The safety coordinator reviews hazards and prevention as part of routine desk work, and that helps us look after pets, travelers, and staff together. We ask you to label belongings clearly and keep important travel papers close at hand. If your pet needs extra care, tell the desk early so the team can plan support with care and respect. Every journey is treated as a shared responsibility, and small steps from travelers make a real difference.

If you have a concern before departure, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
